panel.$description: Inner padding of a panel or docked region, between its edge and its content. Changes with the density setting.

card.$description: Inner padding of a card or other discrete content block. Changes with the density setting.

control-horizontal.$description: Left and right padding inside a control (button, field, dropdown). Changes with the density setting.

control-vertical.$description: Top and bottom padding inside a control (button, field, dropdown). Changes with the density setting.

card.$description: Space between cards or content blocks in a list or grid. Changes with the density setting.

control.$description: Space between neighbouring controls in a row. Compact = 6, the desktop app's control gap (D-32).

card.$description: Corner radius of cards and panels' content blocks. Changes with the density setting.

control.$description: Corner radius of controls (buttons, fields, dropdowns). Changes with the density setting.
